premises.text: Social transactions complement interactions on location-based services like Foursquare
premises.evidence_span: the types of transactions that we're seeing from our users are sort of these social transactions that seem to fit really well and actually complement the types of interactions that take place on Foursquare

premises.text: Giphy allows users to hide real money at real-world locations for friends to find
premises.evidence_span: Giphy is an iPhone application that lets people hide real money at real-world locations for their friends to find by checking in through Foursquare

premises.text: Users do not need the Giphy application to receive gifts
premises.evidence_span: the great thing about Giphy is that your friends don't need to have the application to receive a gift from you

premises.text: Giphy can enhance customer loyalty and engagement for businesses
premises.evidence_span: imagine how businesses and major brands can benefit from Giphy

value.text: Giphy makes social interactions more engaging and fun
value.evidence_span: What a great way for businesses and to show their customers, and more importantly, their customers' friends, about how they think about loyalty, service, and hospitality

notes: No separate premises for the various examples of Giphy use cases as they illustrate the same premise of enhancing social interactions.
